falsifiable_hypothesis: Each frozen outer plan contains eight two-dose heads and sixteen three-dose heads. Two-dose heads carry one fewer paid coordinate and therefore have structurally less within-head information. The current fitting-only global gain shrink already computes a scalar s=1/(2+mean target gain reliability). Reusing that same scalar once more for two-dose heads gives them one additional pooling step without introducing another tuned strength or target identity rule.
gain_rule: Reproduce reliability_counted_common_gain_shrink through g_raw/fallback, prior gain g0, target gain reliability r_g, common gain g_common, and global strength s=1/(2+mean_j r_g,j). If use_raw is false, preserve the existing fallback gain exactly. If use_raw is true, first compute g_global=(1-s)g_raw+s*g_common for all targets. Read the frozen reference plan's coordinate_target_indices and count paid coordinates per target. For heads with count=2 only, apply the same s a second time: gB_j=(1-s)g_global,j+s*g_common,j. For count=3 heads, gB_j=g_global,j. No target name, target outcome, or outer-held loss is used.
theta_rule: Reproduce reliability_counted_common_gain_shrink theta logic exactly using deployed gB: theta bias reliability r_theta, A theta=theta_full+(1+r_theta)*bias, B common weights gB^2*theta_full^2*r_theta, tuning-free weighted median common bias, and thetaB=theta_full+bias+mu_B+r_theta*(bias-mu_B).
cardinality_rationale: The only routing variable is the already-frozen physical head cardinality from the authenticated 64-well plan. Every outer plan must contain exactly eight two-dose and sixteen three-dose heads. The extra pooling coefficient is not new: it is exactly the same fitting-only s already computed for the global step. This remains repeated adaptive development because preceding outer outcomes were inspected.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
